issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies the Farm attribute 'animals' as private (indicated by '-' in the UML) and the text instructs students to provide a getter and setter. However, the provided solution declares the field as public (public List<Animal> animals;). This visibility mismatch can confuse students about whether the field should be private with accessors (as implied by the instructions/UML) or public, and may lead to inconsistent implementations.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Farm.animals field private in the solution (private List<Animal> animals;) and rely on the provided getter and setter, aligning the implementation with the UML and textual instructions. Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to explicitly allow a public field if that was intended.
